title: TABLECONTENT single-cell row, column and table margins

scope.operation: Write type-2 row, type-3 column and type-4 table margin-only style profiles through the legacy 1x1 serializer.
scope.profile: Generated AC1027 1x1 scalar TABLECONTENT, each selected scope independently, in ASCII and binary DXF.
scope.source_basis: The multi-cell writer already passed these row/column/table margin scopes to writeStyle and had selected ASCII/binary evidence. The legacy 1x1 branch admitted only default row/column/table scopes and emitted null style pointers, so it rejected or dropped the same metadata. This qualifies the bounded 1x1 path and complements the existing cell-scope and grid-scope margin receipts.
limits: One type-2, type-3 or type-4 scope per generated 1x1 table
All six margins are finite and nonnegative
No border, format, custom-data or TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP dependency
scope.claim_boundary: Selected DXF serializer and typed readback evidence only; no independent producer, native rendering, DWG output or general margin-domain claim.

implementation: Admit the selected row, column and table margin-only scopes in the 1x1 path using the existing six-margin validation.
Pass the admitted column, row and table style objects into their writeStyle calls instead of emitting null/default bodies.

evidence.physical_wire: For each scope and encoding, independent wire walking confirms one selected type/hasData pair, margin override flag 1, and the exact six ordered group-40 values.
evidence.typed_readback: Fresh imports preserve the selected type-2, type-3 or type-4 style and all six margins.
evidence.failure_control: A negative horizontal margin is refused; the destination sentinel, table collection and explicit invalid caller value remain unchanged.
evidence.retry_control: Restoring the positive margin permits same-adapter retry; fresh typed readback confirms the corrected value.

remaining: The parent P5 rendering/TABLE phase remains open.
Other TABLEFORMAT properties, borders, dependencies, native rendering and DWG output are not claimed.
